intents.behaviour: A second user with an already-registered email is rejected and not persisted
intents.trigger: submits the user form with an email that already exists
preconditions: a user with that email already exists
intents.expected_outcome: 409 Conflict, no second record stored, existing user unchanged
intents.business_rule: BR-004: email addresses are unique across accounts

risk.impact: duplicate identities corrupt login and password reset

intents.layer_rationale: Server-side rule: provable at the API; the UI layer above it was rejected because it adds only rendering
